result.note: A lobbying request with no decision yet; tested only the existing 10% cap on airport operators' airline stakes, a durable regulatory fact.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, Gautam Adani asked the Union government to dilute a rule that limits how much of an airline an airport operator may own. What is the cap on an airport operator's airline stake under that rule?
questions.explain: The rule caps airport operators at a 10% stake in an airline. Adani sought its dilution to break the IndiGo and Air India duopoly, which holds roughly 90% of domestic traffic.
